data.long_meaning: The meaning of Thaddee is recorded in name-lists as “Attacher, Heart”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Thaddee expresses “Attacher, Heart”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Thaddee total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

in_hebrew.name: תדתי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Thaddee is derived from the Hebrew word 'taddathi' which means 'gift of God'. It is a beautiful name that signifies the blessings and goodness of God.

in_greek.name: Θαδδαιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Thaddee in Greek is 'Thaddaios', which means 'attendant, servant of God'. It is a name that reflects the devotion and commitment to serve the Lord.

in_latin.name: Thaddaeus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Thaddee in Latin is 'Thaddaeus', which means 'gift of God'. It is a name that celebrates the divine gift of life and the blessings that come from God.
